regions.breakdown: 路面 (romen): road surface; 凍結 (tōketsu): freezing; 注意 (chūi): caution/warning. A common warning for slippery conditions.

regions.original: 足元にご注意ください
regions.breakdown: 足元 (ashimoto): underfoot, at one's feet; に (ni): particle; ご注意 (go-chūi): polite form of 'caution'; ください (kudasai): polite request 'please do'.
ご (go): honorific prefix; 近隣 (kinrin): neighborhood; の (no): possessive particle; 皆様 (minasama): everyone (polite); へ (e): particle 'to'.

where_youd_see_it: You would see these signs at a construction site entrance or along a road, especially in winter.
cultural_note: Construction sites in Japan frequently display polite notices to local residents, apologizing for inconvenience and detailing work schedules, alongside safety warnings like these.
